description: A React functional component that displays and edits user settings, including fetching and updating data via network calls.

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Sends updated user settings to the backend and updates local state.

methods.name: handleTextInputChange
methods.description: Updates the local state when a user modifies a setting input.

methods.name: normalizeTeams
methods.description: Normalizes various formats of team data into a consistent structure.

methods.name: renderTeamsEditor
methods.description: Renders the UI for managing team entries within user settings.

methods.name: renderEditableField
methods.description: Renders appropriate input controls based on setting type and schema.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Displays setting values in a user-readable format.
